name: Baños de la Encina (Spain)
description: Green field with a yellow horizontal stripe across the centre, charged with the crowned municipal arms of Baños de la Encina (a saint's figure and a holm oak on yellow).
history: Municipal flag of Baños de la Encina; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: Baños de la Encina arms — saint's figure and holm oak on yellow
